notes: The C++ TCK supplies two schema-valid FOM modules that declare the same transportation name and reliability but different Semantics descriptions. The public Create Federation Execution path and the Join Federation Execution additional-module path both accept the union and expose the transportation through standard handle/name lookup. This is bounded evidence for the rule that only FDD data participates in FOM-module combination; it does not assert which prose value is retained, description quality, other OMT elements, interoperability, or conformance.
